strings.configallowadditionalcssclasses: Adds a configuration option to Text block instances allowing additional CSS classes to be set.
strings.configclasses_help: The purpose of this configuration is to aid with theming by helping distinguish text blocks from each other. Any CSS classes entered here (space delimited) will be appended to the block's default classes.
strings.html:myaddinstance: Add a new text block to Dashboard
strings.privacy:metadata:block: The Text block stores all of its data within the block subsystem.
